summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K containing its consolidated financial results for fiscal year 2025 under Japanese GAAP. The filing reports ordinary income of ¥9,085,438 million and profit attributable to owners of parent of ¥1,248,632 million, with earnings per share of ¥502.92. It also announces an ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 26, 2026, and dividend payments. This is a routine earnings release and shareholder meeting notice, not a special situation event. No extraordinary corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved.
